case_title: Amit Rana @ Koka & Anr. v. The State of Haryana
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 307 IPC and sentenced to 14 years rigorous imprisonment and fine
neutral_facts: The accused attempted to murder the victim, resulting in the victim sustaining a spinal injury and becoming paralyzed. The victim was admitted to the hospital with a history of gunshot injury, and a medical officer confirmed the presence of a foreign body in the spine. The injury led to paralysis, indicating that the attempt to murder caused significant harm. The prosecution relied on medical evidence and the recovery of the foreign body to establish the injury and the attempt to commit murder.
